name: Ventricular cardiomyocyte coupling, T-tubules and excitability
rationale: Members concern the cardiomyocyte structures that couple and excite ventricular muscle (cell-cell adhesion, gap junctions, T-tubules, action potential and depolarization control), unlike confusables centred on conduction system, ion channel phases or calcium handling.

qualifier: SWI/SNF (BAF) and CHD remodelers with protein acetylation
name: BAF and CHD chromatin remodeling with protein acetylation
rationale: Members center on nucleosome remodeling complexes (BAF variants, CHD subfamilies, NuRD) and acetyltransferase activity, distinguishing the theme from confusables focused on histone deacetylation, methylation or centromeric chromatin.

qualifier: iodide and sulfate handling linked to thyroid hormone
name: Thyroid hormone action and iodide/sulfate anion transport
rationale: Members combine iodide, sulfate, oxalate and SLC26 anion transport (with PAPS sulfate activation) and thyroid hormone generation and response, whereas confusables emphasize selenium metabolism, sulfonation or hydrogen peroxide.

qualifier: splicing, nuclear export and quality-control surveillance
name: mRNA splicing, nuclear export and quality-control decay
rationale: Members cover pre-mRNA splicing, 3'-end processing, mRNA/snRNA export and nuclear and ribosome-coupled RNA surveillance and decay, unlike the main confusable centred on rRNA transcription and processing.

name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta clearance
rationale: Members describe microglial proliferation, migration, cytotoxicity and activation together with clearance of amyloid-beta and apoptotic cells, whereas confusables carry DAP12/TREM2 signaling, negative microglial regulation and lipoprotein sensing.

name: p75 neurotrophin receptor signaling and axon regeneration
rationale: Members are p75NTR signaling branches (death, survival, RHOA axonal inhibition) plus regeneration of injured axons, distinguishing them from confusables on collateral sprouting, dependence receptors and TRK signaling.

name: Epithelial plasma membrane solute carriers and cystine transport
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane transporter modules plus cystine transport and its cystinuria defects, whereas confusables are neutral amino acid, peptide or urate transport.

qualifier: leptin, ghrelin and growth hormone signaling
name: Appetite and body growth regulation by leptin and growth hormone
rationale: Members govern feeding behavior and organism growth through leptin, ghrelin and growth hormone/IGF signaling, unlike confusables on prolactin, glucocorticoid or GPCR-mediated gut hormone signaling.

name: Sensory-guided, social and vocal behavior
rationale: Members are behaviors driven by auditory, visual and mechanosensory input, social interaction and vocal learning, distinguishing them from confusables on MECP2 regulation and motor or locomotor behavior.

name: Thyroid hormone nuclear receptor transcriptional signaling
rationale: Members concern thyroid hormone response via nuclear receptor transcription (including receptor SUMOylation), unlike confusables on thyroid hormone generation/transport, sex steroid receptors or LXR.

name: KIT mutant binding and resistance to kinase inhibitors
rationale: All members describe KIT mutants binding or resisting TKIs, separating them from the PDGFR and FLT3 resistance confusables and KIT mutant signaling.

qualifier: phosphatase feedback with IL-6 and AP-1 output
name: MAPK signaling attenuation by phosphatases, with IL-6 and AP-1
rationale: Members center on negative feedback and dephosphorylation of ERK/p38/JNK cascades alongside IL-6/STAT3 and AP-1 output, unlike confusables on RAS/RAF activation or TAK1-driven stress kinase activation.

name: Motile axoneme assembly and tubulin post-translational modification
rationale: Members cover dynein arm, central apparatus and sperm axoneme assembly with tubulin folding, glutamylation and severing, unlike confusables on intraflagellar transport, primary cilia or centrosomes.

name: Tight junction regulation of endothelial and blood-brain barriers
rationale: All members regulate bicellular tight junction assembly, disassembly or barrier permeability in endothelium, whereas confusables are adherens junction and cadherin adhesion.

qualifier: sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and egg binding
name: Sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction and fertilization
rationale: Members describe sperm maturation, motility, acrosome reaction, zona pellucida binding and egg activation, unlike confusables on axoneme assembly, germ cell development or maternal-to-zygotic transition.

name: TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members are proximal TCR signaling events modulated by CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition, distinguishing them from BCR and ITK/PKC second-messenger confusables.

name: Neuronal dendritic arbor branching
rationale: All three members concern dendrite branching and arborization, unlike confusables on filopodia, postsynaptic structure or EPHB signaling.

name: Rac-driven Arp2/3 actin polymerization and lamellipodia
rationale: Members center on RAC1/2/3 and RHOG cycles driving WAVE/Arp2/3 actin, lamellipodia and NADPH oxidase, unlike CDC42, RHOA-family or Fc-gamma phagocytosis confusables.

name: Rho GTPase-driven immunological synapse and T cell polarity
rationale: Members describe lymphocyte synapse formation, raft localization, polarity and aggregation via RHOH, Cdc42 and Rho effectors, unlike confusables on antigen presentation, integrin adhesion or homing.

name: Gonadotropin and activin control of gonad and follicle development
rationale: Members span gonadotropin and activin/AMH signaling, follicle growth, ovulation, oocyte maturation and testis somatic cells, unlike confusables on sex determination, primordial germ cells or progesterone synthesis.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, NTP hydrolysis and thiopurine drugs
name: De novo purine synthesis, NTP hydrolysis and thiopurine metabolism
rationale: Members cover de novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis, nucleoside triphosphate catabolism and thiopurine (azathioprine/TPMT) metabolism, unlike confusables on purine salvage, pyrimidine metabolism or nucleoside transport.

qualifier: regulation of MHC class II peptide loading
name: Regulation of MHC class II peptide antigen presentation
rationale: Members concern regulation of peptide antigen loading onto and presentation by MHC class II, unlike confusables on exogenous antigen processing, lipid antigen/CD1 or myeloid surface signatures.

name: DNA and protein methylation in heterochromatin silencing and imprinting
rationale: Members combine DNA methylation, PRC2 and lysine/arginine methylation with imprinting and facultative heterochromatin, unlike confusables centered on KMT2/WDR5 lysine methyltransferases, demethylases or X inactivation.

name: Regulation of keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis, unlike confusables on cornified envelope, hair follicle and appendage development or wound migration.

name: Inhibition of cell-matrix adhesion, spreading and lamellipodia
rationale: Members negatively regulate integrin signaling, substrate adhesion, spreading, lamellipodia and Rac/Rho signaling, whereas confusables promote protrusion or concern invadopodia and phosphatase signaling.
